text:
Jessica (CS): FYI customer AcmeReports opened an escalation — their downstream ingest jobs started failing right after the model flip to v2.3 last night. They say the API sometimes returns extra human-readable lines interleaved with the JSON payload and their parser throws JSONDecodeError. Attaching minimal repro and request-id they provided.

Nate (Support): Thanks Jess — can you paste the exact request-id and sample response? Also what canary % did we push before the flip?

Jessica (CS): Request id from customer logs: r-20240417-0a9f3c. They reported the flip went from canary 25% -> 100% around 2024-04-17 02:00 UTC. Sample prompt they sent and the raw response body below (sanitized):

```
# prompt (customer sent):
"Return a JSON array of invoice objects. Strict JSON, keys: id (int), total (number), items (array). No commentary."

# response body (raw):
"Note: amounts are estimated based on available info.\n[\n  {\n    \"id\": 10234,\n    \"total\": \"123.45\",\n    \"items\": [\"widget\", \"gadget\"]\n  },\n  {\n    \"id\": 10235,\n    \"total\": 99.0,\n    \"items\": []\n  }\n]"
```

Jessica (CS): Their parser chokes because the first line is human text and total for first object is a string not number. Before the flip they got a clean JSON array. Customer says this broke a nightly batch ingest and retried multiple times, causing higher latency and cost.

Omar (Eng): Hmm — two failure modes here: (1) injected human preface line, (2) numeric values being serialized as strings. Could be a model behavior change or a model config mismatch (response_format/structured_output flags). Can we get the actual API request headers + params? Particularly any structured_output param, temperature, max_tokens, and model name.

Nate (Support): Asked customer for full request headers and they replied with excerpt:

```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-***
model: redwood-alpha-2024-v2.3
temperature: 0.0
structured_output: true
user: acme-reports
```

Simi (ML): If structured_output was set true we normally enforce JSON-only outputs. Two hypotheses: (A) model rollout replaced a supervised wrapper that stripped commentary, or (B) a tokenization/serialization change causes numeric types to be emitted as strings for some batches. We should repro locally with the same model and structured_output param. Omar, can you run a quick curl with the customer's prompt and structured_output enabled?

Omar (Eng): Reproduced locally at 2024-04-17T09:12Z using the same model and structured_output:true. I got the same pattern: a one-line human preface followed by a JSON array; and numeric fields occasionally quoted. Sample response I observed (truncated):

```
Note: estimate based on partial records.\n[\n  {"id": 10234, "total": "123.45", "items": ["widget", "gadget"]}\n]
```

Omar (Eng): Looks like the wrapper that used to strip non-JSON tokens was not applied for some model shards after the flip. Also a downstream serializer is coercing decimals to strings in certain generation paths. Marking P1 since it's breaking parsers. Opening an internal ticket SR-2345.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: rollout redwood-alpha-2024-v2.3 -> 100% completed at 2024-04-17T02:03:05Z.

Anita (SRE): Noted customer impact and spike in error rate on the ingest queue for that region (us-east-1). We're seeing retry storms from acme-reports: their jobs retried 3x before failing. Latency for those requests increased 2.4x due to retries. We should add a temporary mitigation while eng/ML investigate.

Simi (ML): Quick mitigation options: 1) re-enable the older prefilter wrapper for v2.3 shards (if available) as a rollback path, or 2) enforce a hard post-processing step in the API that extracts the first JSON-looking substring before returning to customer when structured_output:true. The latter is quick but risky — might hide other regressions. Prefer rollback to previous model binary for immediate remediation.

Nate (Support): Communicated to customer: created SR-2345, scheduled bridge at 2024-04-17T10:30Z to do live repro with them and collect full request bodies. Provided temporary workaround: add a light pre-step to ignore leading non-{ or [ characters when parsing, or wrap the call in a try/catch and retry with a prompt that explicitly includes: "Output ONLY valid JSON, no extra commentary, and ensure numbers are numeric types". Customer said they'll try the parser tweak but wants full fix asap.

Omar (Eng): I've started a narrow rollback to the v2.2 baseline for that deployment group to stop new failures. Rollback job started at 2024-04-17T09:30Z — monitoring.

Simi (ML): I'll investigate tokenization/serialization path and look at the generation trace for why numeric tokens are being quoted. Possible regression in the postprocessing module that coerces types. I'll attach diffs in SR-2345.

Anita (SRE): Monitoring shows rollback progressing. Error rate from customer drops after 09:36Z. Will confirm full restore of prior behavior before we close ticket.

Jessica (CS): Noted. Customer asked for root cause analysis and ETA for full rollback or patch. I told them we'll follow up after the bridge and postmortem.

Omar (Eng): Next steps: 1) keep rollback to v2.2 until patch released, 2) ML to deliver root cause and test that structured_output:true yields strict JSON, 3) SRE to validate no other customers affected, 4) CS to keep Acme updated.

Nate (Support): Adding thread note: ticket SR-2345 assigned to Omar/Simi. Priority P1. Bridge invite to Acme scheduled.

Jessica (CS): Acme confirmed that their nightly ingest succeeded after we reverted. They want a written RCA and a plan to prevent future breakages on structured outputs.

Omar (Eng): Will draft RCA and include suggested guardrails: pre-deploy unit tests for structured_output, golden-output diff checks, and a canary test that runs the customer's prompt set through structured_output validation.

Simi (ML): I'll add a model-regression test to the CI that checks type fidelity for numeric and enum fields under structured_output mode.

Nate (Support): Closing loop with customer for now; will reopen if any issues on follow-up. SR-2345 remains open until RCA posted.

Jessica (CS): Thanks team.
